Could you save over ₹1 lakh in taxes just by switching mutual funds?💸

SEBI has proposed a major change that could make mutual fund portfolio rebalancing much easier.

Currently, switching from one mutual fund to another can trigger capital gains tax. For example, if your ₹10 lakh investment grows to ₹20 lakh, switching funds could mean paying over ₹1.1 lakh in LTCG tax.

Under SEBI’s proposal, investors who have held their mutual fund units for over a year could potentially switch funds without an immediate capital gains tax bill.

Canva is laying off 1,271 employees. But its exit package is getting people talking. 👀
